description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Switch' that renders a toggle switch UI element. It manages internal checked state and adapts rendering based on props such as 'checked', 'disabled', and 'className'. It uses custom checkbox components and applies dynamic styling and behavior.

methods.name: Switch
methods.description: React functional component that renders a toggle switch with optional controlled or uncontrolled behavior, styled with Tailwind CSS classes.
